description:
The Micargi Rover 24" Beach Cruiser is a stylish, easy-riding bike designed for comfort, simplicity, and everyday cruising. Built with a classic step-through cruiser frame, this bike is perfect for relaxed rides around the neighborhood, beach paths, parks, and boardwalks.
Featuring a 24-inch wheel size, the Rover is ideal for riders who want a bike that’s easier to handle than a full-size 26” cruiser while still offering a smooth, stable ride. The single-speed drivetrain keeps things simple and low-maintenance, while the coaster brake allows for intuitive stopping—just pedal backward to brake.
With wide handlebars, a comfortable saddle, and timeless cruiser styling, the Rover delivers an effortless riding experience with eye-catching colors that stand out.
Key Features:
24” Wheels – Great fit for youth, teens, and smaller adult riders
Single-Speed Drivetrain – Simple, reliable, and easy to maintain
Coaster Brake – Classic pedal-back braking for smooth control
Step-Through Steel Frame – Easy mounting and durable construction
Comfort Saddle – Designed for relaxed, upright riding
Classic Cruiser Handlebars – Comfortable grip and riding position
Full Fenders – Added style and everyday practicality
Ideal For:
Beach and boardwalk cruising
Neighborhood rides
Casual, recreational cycling
Riders looking for a fun, easy-to-use bike
The Micargi Rover 24" Beach Cruiser blends comfort, simplicity, and classic style into a bike that’s perfect for everyday cruising—no fuss, just fun.
